323)༄༅/bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub pa chen po bdud rtsi sman sgrub spros bcas bum dbang dang bcas pa phyag bzhes ji ltar bya tshul gyi sa bcad zin da

tei:div.tei:p: 323) ༄༅/ bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i sgrub pa chen po bdud rtsi sman sgrub spros bcas bum dbang dang bcas pa phyag bzhes ji ltar bya tshul gyi sa bcad zin du bkod pa bzhugs so/ 234) gdod nas rang bzhin rnam dag chos sku'i klong*// 'gag med rang shar gzugs sku dkyil 'khor lha// sna tshogs sprul bsgyur sgyu ma'i gar mkhan mchog bla ma lha dang ḍā kir snying nas 'dud// theg dgu'i yang zhun zab gsal rdo rje'i theg /mtha' dag smin grol gnad gsang la 'dus phyir// zab pa'i mthar thug dgongs 'dus gser chos kyi// smin grol phyag bzhes rim pa 'dir bstan bya// de la 'dir bla ma dgongs pa 'dus pa'i smin byed kyi sgrub pa chen po'i phyag bzhes rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i 325) zhal gyi bdud rtsi dri ma med pa yi ger bkod de skal ldan rnams kyi 'dod pa 'jo ba'i nor bur sbyin par bya ba la/ thog mar sa bcad kyi bsdoms ni/ snyan gsan dbab cing sgrub rdzas yo byad bsag sa yi bdag po rnams la bden tshig brjod/ chu gtor sāts+tsha rgya bzhi gsungs rab bsgrag gtor zlog ling sgrub drag po'i sbyin sreg bya/ de ltar rkyen zlog tshogs gsog ci 'grub 'bad/ de nas sngon 'gror skongs dang yig brgya 'bul/ brgya phyag spang skong zhi ba'i sbyin 326) sreg bya// rtags kyi phyag rgyas rnal 'byor grangs la gdab// sa dbyibs spyi dang bye brag brtag la blangs// sngags dang bya bas sbyang zhing ma traṃ bsgral// gter sba blo dang stangs stabs khro gar bzung*// phur bus bsrung zhing shis brjod gar sdud bya// tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs shing bum sogs bshams// skyabs sems yan lag bdun dang phyi gtor btang*// bdag skyed rgyal tho gzug cing gsol ba gdab// mdun skyed bum skyed so shing sogs byin brlab/ chos skyong bskang gso khrus dang me thun brdeg /dam sri mnan zhing sgo byang phyi nang gdag

/kun tshogs bhur phud bgegs sbyang ḍāk+ki 'gyed// mtshams phur phyag 'tshal maṇ+ḍal chos bshad bya// skyabs sems sdom bzung gnas gsum byin gyis brlab// so shing khyor chu srung skud ku sha sbyin// lo rgyus bshad nas shis brjod 'du tshogs dgyes// btang rag tshogs mchod gtor bsngo gsol gdab bya// lha tshogs nam mkhar btegs nas rdzas rnams bsdu'o/ sngon 'gro thun mong khyad par yongs rdzogs pa'o/ ༈ dngos gzhi dang por chag chag thig tshon bri// bum sogs bcas bshad lha tshogs bskos la gdab// dkyil 'khor rgyan dang sgrub rdzas shar gdab dgod// bsangs sbyangs skyabs sems tshogs bsags srung mtshams bcad// chos bshad slob dpon mched lcam mnga' gsol 'bul// rtags gdab brda' sgo brda' phyag byin 'bebs bya// yan lag bdun pa bdag mdun bum skyed sogs// dkyil chog bskang gso tshogs las yongs rdzogs btags// nang par dkyil chog yongs rdzogs gzhung bsang la// dkyil 'khor phyi 'jug nang 'jug lha sngags kyi// dag pa so sor rgyas bshad 'dzab dgongs phogs// 'dzab bskul zhag gsum la sogs 328) ci rigs sgrubs// de tshe sman dang sbrel na khrom bu bsham// sbyang dang bzhu btul 'dzab bcas bsgrub byas la// slar yang btags btsags sbol gzhal rgyas btab bshams// rta bros bgegs bskrad sman gyi byin rlabs ni// dus drug myul le bskrad bcas 'dzab 'bungs sgrubs// rta then nu mo las byang bstod bskul 'bad// maṇ+ḍal zhal bsgyur tshe dbang rdzas sogs bshams// tho rangs sgrub khog gzhung ltar dngos grub blangs// bdud rtsi'i dngos grub len chog sman dbang bskur// rgya dkrol sman mchod dngos grub rdzas chog rol// tshe dbang bskur zhing phyi dro sgrub lung sbyin/ rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gtum mo'i me dbang bya// ༈ de nas spros bcas bum dbang mtha' rten bcas//

rab 'byams sku gsung thugs yon phrin las dang*// gsang ba rdo rje slob dpon don dam bcud// yon tan mchod rdzas phrin las srog dbang dang*// dbang gi byin 329) sreg la sogs skabs bskur bya// dngos gzhi sgrub sman dbang kun yongs rdzogs pa'o// rjes ni drag las bcas gsar bskul chen btags// mkhyen gsol gzugs dpang bsgral las chos skyong bskul// phyi nang thod dkrol btang rag zor sgo dbye// 'chad mod gtor zor bstan skyong gtor bro bya// btang rag mchod bstod dngos grub gtor dbang zhu// gshegs gsol bsngo smon bsdu mchog kun grub tshe// rdo rje slob dpon stegs bu'i steng bzhugs la// sku drin gso zhing mar me smon lam gdab// shis brjod gter sba rdul tshon gshegs gnas bsrung*// rjes kyi rim pa mtha' dag yongs grub pa'o// ༈ de lta bus sgrub chen gyi sa bcad spyi sdom gyi rim pa mdor bstan nas/ bye brag tu phyag bzhes kyi las rim ji ltar bya tshul rgyas par bshad pa ni/ de yang gsang sngags theg chen bla 330) med kyi dbang dang sgrub pa chen po 'di lta bu ston par byed pa'i rdo rje'i slob dpon mtshan nyid dang ldan pa gang de nyid/ sngon du bdag nyid rtsa ba gsum gyi bsnyen pa grangs dus rtags kyi rim pa dang bcas pa gzhung dang mthun par tshad du 'khyol ba dang*/ rang don du spros med kyi sgrub pa'i rigs gang dang gang dag rnams kyang nus ldan rtags thon du sgrubs pa ni gces pa kho na yin phyir de lta bu sngaun du btags la/ rigs gang dang gang rnams kyang nus ldan rtags thon du sgrubs pa ni mchog tu gces pa kho na yin phyir de lta bu sngon du btang la/ ༈ de nas mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i slob ma rnams kyis kyang lo zla'o gong nas slob dpon la snyan gsan dbab pa dang*/ bla mas kyang sgrub pa chen po la dgos pa'o yo byad kyi sta gon/

bsnyen pa kha gso ba'i rigs sogs grub par byas la/ de nas sgrub pa dngos kyi dus tshes phun sum tshogs pa'i skabs la nam babs pa'i tshe/ thog mar thun mong gi sngon du 'gro ba'i las khrigs la/ dang po sa chog sta gon 331) las/ sa bslang ni/ yul can mi la bslang ba ni bza' btung bden tshig dkrol ba sogs kyis bslang zhing*/ mi ma yin rnams la ni bsangs dang bsur mchod la sogs pas tshim par byas te sa bslang ba'i cho ga bya zhing ma mo'i mdos sam/ rgyal mdos dang lha 'dre stong phrag sogs kyi bar chad bsal/ ri rgya klung rgya lam rgya dmag rgya*/ rgya bzhi bsdams pa/ sāts+tsha/ chu gtor/ gsungs rab bsgrags pa sogs kyi rgyab chos dkar chos gang 'grub dang*/ bka' brgyad dang phur pa gang rung gi gtor sgrub longs skabs bstun pa'i zhag grangs kyi sgrubs nas/ dam sri mnan pa'i liṅga dang thun la sogs kyang 'di'i khongs nas nan tan du bsgrub cing gtor zlog tshul ldan du bya ba dang*/ drag po'i sbyin sreg la dgos pa'i liṅga yang brgya phrag tsam du sta gon byas la 'di dus lhan cig tu bsgrub pa'i 332) mthar/ sgrub pa chen po la bar du gcod pa'i bgegs rigs rdul du rlog pa'i drag po'i sreg kyang rgyas par bya ba rab tu gces te/ mdor na 'di yan chad mtha' dag ni sgrub pa'i sngon nas bar chad bsal ba'i rten 'brel gyi cho ga yin phyir/ sgrub pa'i zhag grangs sgong la mi the ba nyid do/ ༈ de nas sngon 'gro dngos kyi zhag dang po la/ na rag skongs bshags yig brgya spang skong phyag rgya la sogs sgrub pa po thams cad kyi nyams chags bshags pa'i thabs la 'bad cing*/ sdig sgrib sbyong phyir la dmigs nas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg dang de'i blud chog sogs gnad kyi zhal gdams nas 'byung ba ltar bya ba yang gter ston brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes yin la/ 'di nas bzung ste sgrub chen la zhugs mkhan ji tsam yod pa'i grangs dang mthun pa'i rdo rje slob dpon gyi phyag rtags bkram nas grangs nges su byas la/

phyag rtags dang mi ldan pa ni sgrub pa'i khongs su mi gzhug pa yang bar chad mi 'byung ba'i rten 'brel thabs gnad zab mo ste/ de ltar 'di yan chad sngon 'gro'i zhag dang po'o/ zhag gnyis pa la/ sa brtag blang ba/ sbyang ba rnams dkyil chog chen po las 'byung ba bzhin dang*/ sbyang ba tshul bzhin byas pa'i sa de nyid stegs bu'i gnas su spungs pa la ma traṃ gzugs gzhung bzhin bzos la/ ging dang rol mo ba sogs tshags su chud pa dang*/ thams cad tshogs te bla mas 'dus pa rnams la ma traṃ gyi lo rgyus bshad la/ mkhyen gsol gzugs dpang ma traṃ bskyed chog dgugs bstim drag po lan mang po dang bcas pa bya zhing*/ 'di skabs kyi bdag bskyed ni mngon rtogs chen mo ltar gyi rta mgrin kho na bskyed par bsngags so/ de nas ging pa rnams 'then pas 334) sgrub khog gi gzhung nas ji ltar gsungs pa'i ma traṃ mnan chog tshul bzhin byas nas/ rdo rje slon dpon nyid de'i dbus su gar dbyangs dang bcas pas matraṃ mnan chog bya/ stegs bu rgyun zhag tu bzo na 'di skabs sa gtair sba ba spyi dang mtshungs par bya ba yin la/ de nas sa bzung ba la blos bzung tshul ni gzhung nyid kyi go sla mod kyi/ stangs stabs kyis bzung ba ni/ dkyil 'khor gtso bo rdo rje slob dpon nus ldan gyi rgyal thob brgyad dang bcas pa chas kyis rab tu brgyan zhing rdo rje dril bu 'chang ba hūm̐ gi glu chen 'byin bzhin pas lam la zhugs rdo rje'i 'gros kyis stegs bu bskor nas/ dbus dang phyogs mtshams so sor 'khod pa'i mdun du mchod gtor mdor bsdus bshams te/ skyabs 335) sems yan lag bdun dang lce lag rdor dril mchod gtor byin rlabs sogs nas bzung ste gtso bo dgu'i bdag bskyed spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol dbang bskur rgyas gdab mchod bstod bzlas pa'i bar gzhung bsrang*/ slob dpon gyi lha la gsol ba gdab pa dang*/

phyogs mtshams kyi rgyal thebs rnams kyis gtso bo nyid la gsol ba btab pa sogs grub rjes badz+ra u tiṣ+ṭha yi sngags dang phyag rgyas ye shes btegs la/ slar las kyi rta mgrin bskyed nas/ chos sku rnam dag mtshan ma kun spangs kyang*// zhes sogs kyi bgegs rigs la bka' bsgo zhing bden stobs brjod pas bskrad/ de nas khro gar gyi bzung ba dngos ni/ 'byung 'dus dang bskrad gzir la sogs pa'i stangs stabs kyis sa gzhi'i bar chad bsal/ rdo rje khyung gshog 'gros dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i 'gros la 336) sogs pas sa gzhi zil gyis mnan zhing bcags/ phar phyin lnga'i bgros kyis sa gzhi byin gyis brlab par bya/ de rjes sa bsrung kyi ngang nas log par bya/ de rjes sa bsrung ba'i phyir bu khro bor mnga' gsol ba dkyil 'khor gyi stegs bu'i byang shar mtshams su btab la/ gar gyi sdud 'gros khams gsum dbang bsdud kyi ngang nas log par bya'o/ zhag gsum pa la dkyil 'khor sta gon/ bum pa sta gon/ lha lta gon/ slob ma sta gon dang bcas pa rnams las/ dang po ni/ stegs bu'i khar thig chen brgyad dang ling tshe dgu thig btab la/ lha so so'i rtsa sngags bum sgrub dbang chen mo ltar dngabacas pas dri'i thig le byas pa'i khar tshom bu dgod de/ de yang dbus kyi gtso mchog la tshom bu gzhan gyi lnga 'gyur dang*/ 'khor gyi gtso brgyad la gsum 'gyur/ 'khor phal ba la re rai/ sgo mtshams dang dpa' bo dpa' mo rnams latshom bu phal gyi sum 337) cha tsam du dgod/ bum pa sta gon ni/ phyag bzhes la lar dngos gzhi'i rgyan dgod kyi sngon der mdzad pa'ang yod mod kyi/ spyi 'gro ltar na 'dir bya ba ste/ de yang rdo rje slob dpon gyi mdun du gdan mdzes gtsang ma'i khar me tog bkram la/ bum pa dgu las bum dang bcas pa rnams gu gul gyis bdug cing bgegs bskrad/ kha rgyan mgul 'ching gzungs thag bum rdzas chu sogs thams cad bshams la/

dkyil chog nas 'byung ba ltar gyi bum pa bca' ba'i rim pa rnams zhib par bya ste/ bum pa rnams dkyil 'khor dbus su lding khri'i khar phyogs mtshams ma 'khrug par dgod/ gzhan yang lha'i sku rten tsak+ka li rnams dang*/ phyi rim du mtshams phur so shing*/ srung skud/ khyor chu ku sha sogs slob ma sta gon gyi yo byad mtha' dag tshang bar bshams pa'i dkyil 'khor 338) gyi mtha' skor du phyi nang gi mchod gtor gyis skor la/ skyabs sems yan lag bdun sogs sngon du btang ste/ sngon gtor la babs pa'i tshe/ dpon slob rnams phyi rol bla gab med par phyin nas bsangs bsur gyi mchod pa dang bcas pas dkar phyogs skyong ba'i gzhi bdag la gser skyems lan chags bgegs rigs kyi 'byung gtor dang*/ spyi dang mthun pa'i cha gsum gtor ma sogs kyang rgyas par bshams la de dag gi cho ga'i rim pa rnams kyang tshul bzhin du bya/ nang du log nas bsrung 'khor mtshams gcod nas bzung ste bdag bdag bskyed 'dzab yan chad grub pa dang*/ slar phyi rol gyi phyogs bzhir 'jig rten skyong ba'i rgyal chen bzhi po'i tho sku rten 'phan dar dang bcas pa gtsug la/ de dag so sor gser skyems gtor mchod bshams nas cho ga gnyer gtad rab 339) gnas shis brjod dang bcas pa gzhung ltar phyogs bzhir rim can du byas te/ nang du log tshe slob dpon gyis dkyil 'khor sa la gsol gdab bya zhing*/ slar rim bzhin mdun bskyed bum bskyed sogs dkyil chog yongs rdzogs bzlas pa dang bcas pa'i mthar/ mtshams phur so shing sogs tha dad kyi bskyed bzlas dang*/ khyor chu ku sha sogs kyi byin rlabs bzlas pa sngags thams cad skabs bstun ci 'grub bya/ chos skyong rnams kyis bskang gso/ bka' srung gter srung gi gtor ma dger 'bul sogs mdor na tshogs las la thug gi bar mtha' dag grub par bya zhing*/ dam sri mnan pa'i ling sgrub rgyas pa sngon du ma sgrub na ni 'di dus gdab pa las drug thams cad zhib par bya dgos pa nyid do/

de nas phyi rol tu slob ma grangs nges gang yod rnams la khrus chog dang me thun brdeg 340) pa la sogs bgegs sbyang ba'i cho ga rnams byas nas sgrub khang skor ba byed cing yig brgya bzlas bzhug slob dpon dang rgyal thebs sogs dpon slob rnams kyis sgrub khang them 'og tu dam sri mnon pa'i las rim dang*/ sgo byang phyi nang gdag cing so so'i skyed chog dgug bstim mchod gtor gnyer gtad rab gnas dang bcas gzhung bzhin bya/ de nas slob ma rnams nang du tshogs nas/ dang po byur phud pa/ bgegs sbyang ba/ ḍak+ki 'gyed pa/ mtshams phur gdab pa rnams dang*/ phyag 'tshal/ maṇ+ḍal/ chos bshad/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ sdom bzung*/ gnas sum byin rlabs/ so shing dor ba/ khyor chu sbyin pa/ srung skud gdab pa/ ku sha sbyin pa dang bcas pa'i slob ma sta gon gyi chos bcogs so rnams dbang gzhungachen mo smin byed snying gi me long nyid nas ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin thar chags su bya zhing*/ bla mas 341) sta gon gyi dgos ched dang dag sbyor bshad de shis pa brjod nas tshogs pa rnams gyis la/ dpon slob rnams kyis dkyil 'khor sa la btang rag gi mchod bstod/ tshogs 'khor/ srung ma spyi la gtor 'bul sogs bya zhing*/ dkyil 'khor gyi phyogs bzhi nas gsol ba gdab pa dang*/ ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya ting 'dzin byas nas/ rdzas dang yo byad thams cad gtsang sar bsdu'o/ de ltar 'di yan chad rnams sngon 'gro sta gon gyi las rim mo/ de nas zhag bzhi pa'i tshe/ dngos gzhi'i las rim rnams kyi dang por/ phyi nang gsang gsum gyi chag chag gdab cing thig chog rgyas par byas te dkyil 'khor gyi thig gzhung bzhin btab/ rdul tshon byin gyis brlab la dkyil 'khor nor 'khrul med par bris nas/ yig brgyas kha bskang zhing rol mos 342)byin phabs pas ye shes kyi dkyil 'khor nam mkhar btegs pa de nyid rdul tshon dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor la bstim mo/

zhag lnga pa'i tshe/ thog mar slob dpon gyi mdun du gzhi ma gtsang ma rgya cher bting ba'i khar me tog bsil ma bkram nas/ bum pa rnams dang sku rten/ dbang rdzas/ dkyil 'khor rgyan bkod kyi rdzas dang yo byad mtha' dag go rim bzhin bkram la/ rol dbyangs ting 'dzin dang bcas pas so so'i shar gdab mnga' gsol gyi rim pa rnams gyer zhing*/ las kyi rgyal thebs rnams kyis so so'i gyer tshig dang bstun pas dbang rdzas sgrub rdzas sogs rim pas gdan drangs nas dkyil 'khor du dgod tshul phyag bzhes mthong brgyud ltar bzhugs gsol zhing steng 'og gi rgyan dgos kyi rim pa mtha' dag kyang brjod tshig dang mthun par dgram/ phyi rim mtha' skor du sman 343) rak+ta gtor mchod sogs gya nom pa bkod pa'i khyad par phun sum tshogs pas rtsa gsum lha tshogs chos srung thams cad mnyes shing sgrub pa'i mched lcam kun kyang snang ba 'gyur ba'i bsham bkod dang ldan par bya'o/ zhar la slob dpon mched lcam karma ging chen sogs la mnga' gsol ba'i rtags kyi phyag rgya'i yo byad rgyan chas thams cad kyang ma tshang ba med par dkyil 'khor gyi nye logs gar 'os kyi sar bshams la bzhag go ༈ de nas mchod rdzas bsang sbyang byas te/ skyabs sems bdun dang srung 'khor mtshams gcod kyi bar rnams grub pa dang slob ma rnams tshogs pa la bla mas dal 'byor rnyed dka' mi rtag las 'bras 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal thar pa'i phan yon sogs dang*/ sgos lam khyad par du zab chos dgongs pa 344) 'dus pa'i che ba/ bla ma rgyud pa'i lo rgyus rnams dang*/ yang dgos su sgrub pa chen mo'i 'bab tshul phun sum tshogs pa lnga'i mtshan nyid dgos ched skabs don gyi rnam bshad rgyas bsdus skabs dang sbyar te bshad pa'i mthar/ rgyal thebs rnams kyis ston pa rdo rje'i slob dpon nyid la mnga' gsol ba'i rgyan chas yo byad rnams 'thogs nas/ de'i gyer tshig ma bu gong 'og sprad tshul rnams gzhung bzhin ma nor bar byas la zhi chos khro chas yongs rdzogs dang*/

gzhan yang dbang dgos zab ber pad zhwa sogs mtha' dag dbul zhing mnga' gsol phyag mchod bya/ de rjes bzung ma bu 'dzin gyi lha mi dgu'am/ lnga la sogs pa rnams la yum kun tu bzang mo sogs su mnga' gsol ba'i skabs su/ dpon slob rnams kyis rol dbyangs g.yab rdzas spos dud sogs 345) 'dzom zhing ting 'dzin rnon po dang ldan pas/ mkha' 'gro'i las byang pad+ma'i ze 'bru nas 'byung ba'i ye shes mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren nan tan tu byas bstim pas dam tshig gtsang zhing slob dpon nus pa dang mkha' 'gro'i dam rdzas tshogs na mkha' 'gro spyan 'dren nan tan tu byas bstim pas dam tshig gtsang zhing slob dpon nus pa dang ldan dang mkha' 'gro'i dam rdzas tshogs na mkha' 'gro dngos su babs pas nyes smra ba yang 'byung la 'di skabs su gter ston nyid kyi phyag bzhes man ngag tu/ bum 'dzin gyi gtso mo dang phyogs kyi bum 'dzin gang la babs 'gyur gyi ming byang gi rten 'brel brtag pa'i thabs nges 'grongs yod mod kyang*/ ding sang ni 'di dag gi lag len gnad la mkhal nus kyi dpon slob snod bcud nus pa mnyam pa mi rnyed tshe/ tshul de dag gi bya lugs zhib tu brjod dgos par gyur mod/ ༈ de dag gong gi 'phror/ gzungs ma la zhib chas kyis mnga' 346) gsol ba dang*/ ging pa rnams la ging chas/ gzhan yang rgyal thebs rigs so so mched lcam dral las byed 'dus pa kun la mnga' gsol spyi dang bye brag thams cad tshul bzhin bya zhing*/ dam tshig rtags kyi rgyas gdab pa rnams kyang 'dir bya'o/ ༈ de nas dpon slob kun chas kyis brgyan te gar 'chams spos rol mchod rdzas kyi yo byad sna tshogs 'thogs pas/ dkyil 'khor bskor zhing brda sgo dbye ba/ dur khrod brgyad kyi byin 'bebs sogs kyang skabs dang bstun pas bya'o/ slar yan lag bdun dang phyi nang gi mchod pa byin rlabs sogs nas bzung ste bdag mdun bum gsum bskang gso tshogs las sogs yongs su rdzogs par gzhung bsrang ngo*/

347) zhag drug pa'i tshe thog mar bdag mdun bum gsum mchod bstod rnams 'grub par byas la/ slob ma'i tshogs la dkyil 'khor phyi 'jug nang 'jug gi las rim rnams dbang gzhung chen mo nyid nas 'byung ltar bya ba ste/ khyad par ye shes 'bebs pa'i tshe rtsa ba gsum so so'i spyan 'dren las byang tshangs pa'i sgra dbyangs ltar dang*/ dmigs rim ni byin slobs gter ma'i brda' dbang gi gzhung du yod pa ltar nan tan du 'bog cing bstim/ dam tshig 'bog pa'i dus su ni dam tshig rnam bshad brgya mdud kyi gzhung bzhin dang*/ dkyil 'khor gyi brda don dag sbyor ni dkyil 'khor rnam dag rab bsal dang*/ 'dzab la 'jug pa'i sngon du lha sngags kyi don rnams 'grel ba me tog rgyan nas gsungs pa ltar bshad par bya ste/ 'di dag thams cad slob dpon chen po'i gsung dri ma med 348) pa dgongs 'dus nyid kyi rang gzhung yin pa'i phyir/ chos gzhan las drangs dgos ma mchis so/ ༈ de nas 'dzab la 'jug tshe/ 'dzab dgongs dmigs pa'i 'khrul 'khor gyi gzhung ltar dmigs pa 'bog cing ting 'dzin bslab bya zhib tu byas la/ 'dzab bskul rnams rim pa ltar dbyangs dang bcas pas bskul zhing 'dzab rgyun gyi dbu 'dzugs par bya ba las/ de yang sgrub pa'i zhag grangs ji tsam bya ba'i dang po'i zhag la ni gtso mchog gi 'dzab kho na la 'bad cing thun mtshams la mchod bstod dang bcas pas sgrubs/ zhag gnyis pa la 'khor gyi gtso brgyad so so'i 'dzab bskul dang bcas te sgrubs/ de lhag zhag grangs ji tsam byas pa thams cad spyi dril chen mo 'ba' shig la

'bungs/ phyogs mtshams kyi gzungs thag 349) 'dzin pa'i slob dpon brgyad pos ni gtso bo brgyad po'i ting 'dzin dang bcas pa bya/ de ltar mi lag gis ma lcogs na gang yod kyi spyi dril chen mo la 'bad cing*/ ston pa rdo rje slob dpon nyid kyis ni de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin gyi klong nas rdor bzlas dang spyi dril spel mar bya/ mched lcam la las ni dkyil chog gi gzhung bsrang zhing lha tshogs la mchod bstod dang bka' srung gter srung rnams la bskang gso tshogs mchod sogs rgyun mi 'chad du 'bad/ rdo rje rgyal thebs 'khor bcas kyi nyin mtshan gyi thun drug tu ging gtor 'bul zhing ging bskul byas nas/ ging rnams kyi myul le bskrad pa'i las rim rnams kyang phyag len mthong brgyud ltar dus las mi yol bar bya ba sogs/ mdor na sgrub pa dbu btsugs nas 350) dbang zhal phye'i bar du 'dzab rgyun skad cig kyang lam chad pa dang*/ bskang rgyun sogs le lo'i seng cung zad kyang ma shor ba'i bsgrub par bya'o/ gal te bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa dang sbrel na/ 'di skabs su sngon la gong bzhin rtsa ba'i sgrub pa zhag bdun nam lnga'am gsum sogs gang 'os byas la/ de nas khrol bu sgrub pa'i bcas bsham ste sman sgrub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho'i gzhung nyid nas gsungs pa'i bsangs sbyangs bzhu btul sogs kyi las rim tshul ldan du khrol sgrub zhag gsum sogs skabs bstun du bya zhing*/ slar sman rnams btags btsags sbol ba'i rim pa rnams kyang phyag len ma 'chug pa gzhung dang mthun par byas la gzhal zhing rgyas gdab mnga' gsol gyi las rim rgyas pa dang bcas pas dkyil 'khor du bzhugs su gsol nas dug gsum gyi 351) me sbar nas/ steng nas sku gsum gyi dar khang dbugasal sogs bya ste/ lar bdud rtsi sman gyi sgrub pa 'di la ni 'ol tshod rig dpyod kyis 'grub pa'i sprul ma yin tshe/

bla ma brgyud pa'i zhal gdams phyag bzhes mngon sum du gtan la phebs pa dang*/ nyams myong gi drod thaub pa gal che ba yin pa shes par bya zhing*/ nyin mtshan dus drug tu rta bro bgegs bskrad pa dang*/ sman gyi lha mo spyan 'dren byin 'bebs kyi skabs thams cad du rdo rje rgyal po rgyal thebs bum 'dzin gyi lha mor bcas pa rnams kyis spos dang rol mo gling bu g.yab dar lnga ldan sogs 'dzoms pas gdung ba'i dbyangs kyis bla ma rig 'dzin drang srong yi dam lha tshogs sman gyi lha mo 'byung ba'i lha dang srung ma sogs spyan drangs shing bstim pa'i rdzas sngags ting 'dzin nan tan du 'bad de 352)dpon slob kun dam tshig gi sel ma zhugs cing le lo btang snyom tshod yod gal ma mchis su mi bya bar/ mu gos gdung shugs brtson grus drag pos sman gyi 'dzab dbyangs gsung mi 'chad du sgrog cing rtse gcig tu sgrubs/ mdor na sgrub pa 'di la ni ji srid rtags ma byung gi bar du sgrub pa'i 'phro bshel thabs med tshe/ thog ma nas dpon slob thams cad de lta bu'i go cha dang 'dun pa gcig tu mthun pa gal che'o/ de nas/ 'od dang du ba sgra dang dri/ lha mo'i gzugs kyang ston par byed/ ces pa lta bu'i rtags kyi rim pa so so'i skal ba dang mthun pa naṃ byung ba'i tshe/ nang par dngos grub len rgyu'i nub mo nas maṇ+ḍal zhal bsgyur gyi dkyil 'khor dang*/ tshe sgrub bdud rtsi snying po'i dbang rdzas/ dngos grub kyi rdzas dang yo byad thams cad rgyas par nas de dag gi cho ga dang dngos grub bskul ba'i 'dzab rnams la 'bungs 353)shing las dbyang rgyas pa dang bstod 'bum bskang ba tshe 'gugs tshogs brgya sogs dang*/ khyad par lha gnad la dbab ste dngos grub 'bebs pa'i las rim rnams kyang sman sgrub kyi gzhung bzhin bya/ nang par tho rangs nas sgrub pa'i spra khrid las gsungs pa'i dngos grub blang chog dang bdud rtsi sman gyi dngos grub blang chog sogs rgyas par byas nas dpon slob kun sman bum gyi dbang blang*/

de nas nam langs pa dang sman gyi rgya dkrol te/ mtshan ldan gyi thod par sman phud dzā gad dang sbyar la sman mchod rgyas par byas dngos grub blang zhing sman bog ba dag tshogs kyi dga' ston bya'o/ nyi ma shar ba dang dus sprad de bdud rtsi snying po'i zhawa dbang bskur ba dang*/ de'i nyin sgrub sa lung dbang rgyas par mchad pa yang gter ston gyi phyag bzhes su gda'/ de'i 353)nang sar dngos grub 'phel byed rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg bya zhing*/ nyams len gyi snod ldan rnams la ni gtum mo'i me dbang dga' ba 'khyis pa bde ba'i gsang mdzod kyi dbang yang skabs 'dir bskul bar mdzad do// de nas dbang dngos gzhi spros bcas bum dbang chen mo nyid skabs thab dang bstun dbu gtsug la/ de yang rig pa'i dbang lnga mtha' rten dang bcas pa bskur ba'i dus su/ ston pa'i rdo rje rgyal po rgyan thams cad dang ldan pa bum 'dzin gyi lha mor bcas bas dbang rnams bskur tshe byang sems rnams kyis me tog 'thor zhing shis pa brjod pa dang*/ rig ma rnams kyis rdo rje'i glu blang*/ lha mo rnams kyis mchod pa 'bul/ ta kṛ ta khro bo rnams kyis bgegs skrod pa sogs kyang brjod bya dang mtshungs pa'i chas zhugs sogs phyag len mthong brgyud ltar bya zhing*/ dbang gi rim pa rnams yul 355)dus gang zag gi snod dang ji ltar 'tshams par slob dpon nyid kyis dgogs pas dpyad de zhag grangs dang rgyas bsdus skabs bstun du bya lags/ dbang gong ma rnams kyis tshe slob ma chos kyi rgyun 'dzin gzhan don nus pa'i rigs la ni/ spros med don dbang sreg rtsa dmar 'byin dbang bzhi'i lag len bde stong ram 'byams/ chags chen lam slongs ḍā ki'i srog dbang*/ thod rgal rtsal dbang brda don zung 'brel/ 'khor 'das gzhi rdzogs rang byung don dbang la sogs pa'i dbang chen rnams kyang lhan thabs su ma bu sprad nas bskur tshul dang*/

de bzhin du gcod dbang sgo 'byed/ pu sti'i lung dbang la sogs dbang phran rnams dang*/ gzhan yang*/ btags grol rgyud dbang dang*/ gcod dbang bka' rgya ma dang*/ lam 'bras kyi kyis dbang gud du sbas pa sogs/ 356) 337)nyid kyi rgyal tshabs ston pa'i zhal skyin ston pa'i sgron mer gyur nges la ma gtogs= tshogs sa spyi dang gang zag phal pa dag la bskur du rung ba ni ma yin phyir= gtso bor sno dang sbyor tshul shes dgos la= 'di dag bskur ba'i skabs su ni/ bka' srung rta nag sde brgyad= gter srung 'bar ba bla bdun/ chos kyi rjes 'breng sha za kha mo tshe dang bcas pa rnams kyi las gtor rgyan dalan gzi brjid 'bar bar bshams nas= so so'i gsol mchod rgyas pa nan tan du byed pa yang chos 'khren dang ru dog mi 'byung ba'i thabs gnad gal po che yin pa dang*/ srog dbang chen mo'i tshe dreg pa sde brgyad so so'i chos zhugs rngam pa'i 'khor tshogs dang bcas pa sta gon byas la dpon slob rnams kyi spyan dren drag tu byas pa'i mthar rol mo 358)spyug glu rkang gling bsur dang bcas pas spyan drangs te 'gying 'tshams rngams bstabs dang ldan pas= dbu mar rnams ma rdzogs kyi ring la dpang po'am dmigs rten gyi tshul du bzhugs su gsol zhing sha khrag la gzhi blang pa'i dgregs kyi ling chen bzos pa la dgug gzhug bskral bstabs bya zhing= gtota ma gser skyems sogs rgya cher bul la phrin las gzhol nas gshegs gsol bya ste= de ltar 'di chad thams cad bsgrub dbang dngos gzhi'i rim pa'o/ ༈ de nas rjes kyi las rnams kyi dang por= drog mngon spyod las la mkho ba'i rdzas dang yo byad rnams gsar zhing= yi dam chos skyong gi gtor ma= drag po'i zor rdzas sogs mtha' dag tshags su chud cing*/ phung gsum bdud kyi nyi ma la babs pas dus su= thog mar bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i las byang chos skyong rnams kyi bskang gso gzhung srang

359)tshogs las bskang ba la sogs rgyas pa sngon du btang la= drag sngags phrin las kyi rgyud spu gri reg chod dang zhi khro bka' brgyad sogs las 'byung ba ltar gyi mkhyen gol gzugs dpags thugs dam bskul ba rnams dang bsgral sogs las byang tshangs sgra ltar rgyab par bya zhing*/ bskul 'bum myur 'gyegs gleg 'phreng dang*/ bka' srung spyi dang bye brag pa'i bskul byang gi las rim thams cad grub dang*/ phyi mtshams bsrung ba'i rgyal chen rnams la gser skyems dang dkar gtor= bar mtshams sgo byang gi khro bo gnyis dang*/ nang mtshams bsrung ba'i khro bcu rnams la sman rākadang bcas pas btang rag gi mchod bstod phul zhing rang gnas su gshegs su gsol ba sgrub pa spra khrid las byung ba ltar byas nas sku rten rnams dkrol la the ser rjes mi mngon par la shig 360)༈ de nas dpon slob mched lcam thams cad drag po'i chas su zhugs te/ thog mar las byahang me tog 'phreng mdzeb kyi bskul thung gi bzhes su gsol nas/ chos skyong gi ru dar dang me yis sna drangs la/ las gtor rnams phyir dpag pa dang lhan cig par dpon slob rnams kyis/ bka' brgyad nas 'byung ba'i= shar phyogs dung sgo dkar po phyes/ zhes sogs kyis zer lam dbye zhing*/ phyi rol du sleb pa dang gzhi bdag phyogs skyong rnams la gser skyem phul nas gdong grogs bcol zhing 'gyu phyogs sogs dang mthun pa'i phyogs su kha bltas la/ 'chad mdo'i 'bul gtor zur du byas la phul zhing sngon gyi mtha' tshig gis 'chad med gyer= slar yang rdo rje rgyal pos snang srid kyi lha ma srin rnams la srid pa hu'i phyag rgya bstan zhing*/ 'di ni sangs rgyas gling pa'i gter kha las byung ba dra las ma ched du 360) bsngags so/ bzhes 'bod dang dam bdar byas nas/ las byang chen mo dang rta mgrin nag po'i las gzhung sogs nas byung ba ltar gyi gter gzer gyer la gtor ma rnams 'phang*/

bstan skyong dang gtor bro sogs spyi ltar byas te nang du log tshe dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la btang rig mchod bstod rgya cher byas pa'i mthar= dngos grub blang ba'i skabs 'dir byin rlabs gtor ma brda dbang nyid mtha' rten gyi tshul du bskur ba yang rig 'dzin brgyud pa'i phyag bzhes so/ ༈ de nas dkyil 'khor gshegs su gsol bsdu chog= sngo smon shis brjod sogs rjes chog mtha' dag spyi dang mthun par grub nas= yo byad thams cad bsdus pa'i shul gyi stegs bu'i khar rdo rje slob dpon bzhugs pa'i khri'u bshams pa la bzhugs su gsol/ slob ma kun gyis sku drin btang rag gi mchod gsol 362)'bul nod dang bcas te/ sgrub khog gsungs pa'i sku drin gso zhing smon lam gdab pa'i tshig rnams dang nyes byas bshags pa la sogs nan tan bya= mched lcam 'du tshogs gang yod kun gyi lag tu mar me bzung nas dpon slob kun gyi smon lam dang gzhan yang smon lam shis brjod kyi rigs rgya tshen po bya'o/ ༈ 'di skabs su sgrub rdzas byin rlabs dngos grub kyi rdzas sna tshang ba dang dar smon rin chen 'bru sna sogs bkra shis pa'i num gter gyi yo byad tshul ldan spyi dang mthun par byas pa'i bum pa lnga'am gcig gis rung ba la rgyas btab ste rab tu gnas shing sems skyed smon lam gyis mtshams sbyar bar dkyil 'khor gyi shul du'am gar 'os kyi sar sba zhing tshags bldam/ de nas nang dkyil 'khor gyi rdul tshon rnams rin chen gyi bum pa rgyal ldan du brtsal ba= gzhan yang bum 363)chu/ bdud rtsi chos sman gyi cha shas cung zad dang*/ dngos grub kyi gtor ma'i dum bu sna tshang thod pa mtshan ldan nam rin po che'i snod du blugs gdan drangs shing*/ tshogs kyi yo byad/ spos dang rol mo'i bye brag dar 'phan mchod rdzas ser sbreng dang bcas na chu klung chen po rgyun 'babs kyi 'gram ngogs su 'khyer la=

der dpon slob rnams kyis bdag skyed las gzhung mdor bsdus tshogs mchod dang bcas pa byas pa'i mthar/ rdzas de dag chu bor gshegs pa dang lhan cig tu yig brgya sogs kyi gzungs sngags byin rlabs can 'ur dir du bsgrag cig= bstan 'gro'i don chen dang chos rgyud mi nus rgya cher 'byung ba'i smon lam gdab= bum pa sogs kyi snod rnams stong par mi log par chu gtsang gi bkang nas 'khyer te sgrub khang sogs 364)la 'thor/ de rjes zhag gsum sogs kyi bar gnas bsrung ba dang*/ dga' ston gyi rigs kyang ci 'byor bya ba ni rjes 'jug bkra shis pa'i rten 'brel gyi gnad du che bar gsungs so/ de ltar zab chod dgongs pa 'dus pa'i smin byed sgrub dbang chen mo dngos grub sman dang bral ba'i spros bcas tshom bu tshogs sgrub kyi sgo nas/ rang gzhan smin grol du bya ba'i las rim sngon 'gro dngos gzhi rjes dang bcas pa'i phyag bzhes kyi khrig rim mthar chags ltas mchog tu zin ṇis su btabs pa 'di ni/ gtso bor dgongs 'dus nyid kyi sgrub khog chen mo spra khrid gsal ba'i me long= spros bcas bum dbang chen mo/ lag khrigs gab pa sngon mngon phyungs= sman sgrub bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho sogs las ji ltar gsungs pa bzhin dang*/ phyag len gyi rigs phran= 365)bu kha skongs dkrug sdebs kyi rnam pa dag kyang rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa nyid nas zhal gyi bdud rtsi zam ma chad pa las legs par 'ongs pa kho na ma gtogs gzu lum ras chod kyi dri ma'i bslad pa cung zad tsam yang ma mchis lags pas/ yid brtan gyi phyi mor rung ba nor bu'i phreng ba lta bu 'di ni= rig 'dzin chen po sangs rgyas gling pa'i rigs dang chos kyi ring lugs dri ma med pa 'dzin par rdo rje'i slob dpon rig 'dzin snying po'i spyan sngar/ bdag nyid dus kyi bla ma'i zol gyis 'tsho ba sa mkhas mchog pad+ma legs grub rtsal gyis ye ge'i byed po dang bskul ba por bgyis shing*/

rtse le rig 'dzin yab sras nas brgyud pa sogs rang lugs kyi bla ma brgyud pa rnams kyi phyag bzhes zhal rgyun dag dang yang dgongs pa bstun te 366)bdag cag dpon slob lhan gcig tu go bdur nas phyi rabs kyi gang zag gsar bu dag la phan par bsams te yi ger bkod pa 'dis mtshon chen rab kun gyi dge tshogs dus gsum bsags pa'i rnam dkar mtha' dag gcig tu bsdom pa'i mthu 'bras kyis/ ma rgan mkha' mnyam 'gro rnam mkhyen sangs rgyas kyi go 'phangs la ma 'khod de srid du theg chen bla med rdo rje theg pa'i bstan pa rin po che 'grib med gong nas gong du 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i cha rkyen du gyur cig maṅga lam bha wan+tu//
